label: Bare sample region (air)
tooltip: An air-material cube with no glass wall at all: a chainable train anchor for a BARE particle cloud (no cuvette/vial around it -- e.g. a free-space aerosol/spray measurement volume). Assign 'sample=' (a samples.miesamp row) directly on this body to bind a scattering/absorbing particle population; the beam passes straight through along local +x (a plain pass-through port, like a window).
